trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Input tensors with different numbers of dimensions are passed to a pairwise broadcasting operation.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Two input tensors where one has an extra leading dimension, such as rank 4 and rank 3 tensors, with the trailing dimensions matching and dim=-1.

bug_oracle.description: Calling torch.cosine_similarity with rank-mismatched input tensors raises an exception instead of broadcasting as in the previous version.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Systematically vary the rank and shape of one input tensor while keeping the trailing dimension sizes compatible with the other input tensor.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct pairs of tensors with unequal ranks, such as rank N and rank N-1, with matching sizes along the reduction dimension.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Constrain one tensor to have fewer dimensions than the other while ensuring the target dimension exists in both; test multiple dim positions including negative dims.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call torch.cosine_similarity and similar pairwise broadcasting operations with rank-mismatched tensor pairs across different dim values.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare behavior against documented broadcasting semantics or a previous framework version; an unexpected exception for previously accepted rank-mismatched inputs indicates a bug.
